integrity: Universal claim supported by explicit reproducing-kernel identities and a strict derivative inequality. Exact rational finite checks are supplementary; absence of historical equivalence is not proved.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two nondegenerate adjacent simplices, degree-one continuous finite elements and uniform volume; no larger mesh, general density, or H1 estimate is claimed. Maximal evaluation is attained at an exclusive tip, but other maximizers are not classified.
title: Exact endpoint projection norms on two adjacent simplices
